source_note: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分
english_source_note: Integrating via Binary Expansion of the Variable
callout_id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#8
statement_en: Compute the integral $$\\int_{0}^{1}\\left(\\sum_{n\\geq 1}\\frac{a_n(x)}{3^n}\ight)^2\\,dx,$$ where \\(a_n(x)\\) is the integer given by the \\(n\\)-th digit in the decimal expansion of \\(x\\).
key_techniques: independence of digits of a uniform variable
callout_body: 求积分的结果：$$\int_{0}^{1}\left(\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n(x)}{3^n}\right)^2\,dx$$其中$a_n(x)$为$x$的十进制表示的第$n$位对应的整数。
